content.text:
Here is the complete picture of everything related to integrations in the Rankora project.

---

## 1. IntegrationsTab Component

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/admin/IntegrationsTab.tsx`
(837 lines total)

This is an admin-only component. It is **not** exposed in the user-facing sidebar. It lives inside the `/admin` route and is rendered by the Admin page. It contains 5 collapsible integration cards:

| Card | Key queried | Secret name(s) | Editable fields |
|---|---|---|---|
| OpenAI | `OPENAI_API_KEY` | `OPENAI_API_KEY` (Supabase secret) | None — display + test only |
| Google Gemini | `GEMINI_API_KEY` | `GEMINI_API_KEY` (Supabase secret) | None — display + test only |
| Resend | `RESEND_API_KEY` | `RESEND_API_KEY` | `resend_api_key`, `email_from_address`, `email_from_name`, `inbound_email_domain`, outbound toggles — saved to `platform_config` table |
| Dodo Payments | `DODO_PAYMENTS_API_KEY` | `DODO_PAYMENTS_API_KEY`, `DODO_PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `DODO_PAYMENTS_ENVIRONMENT` | `dodo_payments_environment` (test_mode / live_mode) — saved to `platform_config` table |
| Chat Widget | (no key test) | — | `chat_widget_enabled` toggle + `chat_widget_code` embed textarea — saved to `platform_config` table |

Connection testing is done via the `admin-test-integration` Supabase edge function. Integration status rows are read from a `integrations` table (columns: `key_name`, `last_test_status`, `last_tested_at`).

There is no Supabase connection card — Supabase is the backend itself and is accessed via `src/integrations/supabase/client.ts`.

---

## 2. How IntegrationsTab is wired into the Admin panel

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/pages/Admin.tsx` (lines 11, 27)

```ts
import IntegrationsTab from "@/components/admin/IntegrationsTab";

const sectionComponents: Record<AdminSection, React.ComponentType> = {
  ...
  integrations: IntegrationsTab,
  ...
};
```

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/admin/AdminSidebar.tsx` (lines 38–43)

The admin sidebar's "System" group includes:
```ts
{ key: "integrations", label: "Integrations", icon: Plug },
{ key: "logs",         label: "Usage Logs",   icon: ScrollText },
{ key: "audit_logs",   label: "Audit Logs",   icon: ClipboardList },
{ key: "system_errors",label: "System Errors",icon: AlertTriangle },
```

---

## 3. settingsNav in JobSidebar

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/JobSidebar.tsx` (lines 78–103)

```ts
const settingsNav = [
  {
    icon: CreditCard,
    label: "Billing",
    isActive: pathname === "/billing",
    onClick: () => navigate("/billing"),
  },
  {
    icon: Users,
    label: "Team",
    isActive: pathname === "/team",
    onClick: () => navigate("/team"),
  },
  {
    icon: Globe,
    label: "Career Page",
    isActive: pathname === "/career-settings",
    onClick: () => navigate("/career-settings"),
  },
  {
    icon: Settings,
    label: "Settings",
    isActive: pathname === "/settings",
    onClick: () => navigate("/settings"),
  },
];
```

There is no "Integrations" entry in this array. Integrations is only accessible to admins via `/admin`.

---

## 4. Route definitions in App.tsx

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/App.tsx` (lines 170–199)

Public routes (outside MaintenanceGate):
```
/apply/:jobId          → Apply
/careers/:slug         → CareerPage
/careers/:slug/jobs/:jobId → CareerJobDetail
/shared/:token         → SharedPortal
/book/:token           → BookInterview
```

Protected/authenticated routes (inside MaintenanceGate):
```
/auth                  → Auth
/                      → RootRoute (Index if logged in, LandingPage if not)
/jobs                  → Index (ProtectedRoute)
/profile               → Profile (ProtectedRoute)
/billing               → Billing (ProtectedRoute)
/settings              → Settings (ProtectedRoute)
/team                  → Team (ProtectedRoute)
/tasks                 → Tasks (ProtectedRoute)
/activity              → Activity (ProtectedRoute)
/career-settings       → CareerSettings (ProtectedRoute)
/admin                 → Admin (AdminRoute)
/book-demo             → BookDemo
/request-feature       → RequestFeature
/changelog             → Changelog
/payment/callback      → PaymentCallback
*                      → NotFound
```

There is no `/integrations` route. Integrations are a tab inside `/admin`.

---

## 5. SidebarLayout

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/SidebarLayout.tsx` (lines 1–38)

A thin wrapper used by all authenticated pages. It renders `SidebarProvider` + `JobSidebar` + `SidebarInset` (which contains `AppHeader` and `{children}`). It passes `isAuthenticated={!!user}` to `JobSidebar` so the settingsNav section only shows when logged in.

---

## Summary of gaps relevant to adding an Integrations page

- There is **no `/integrations` route** and no "Integrations" entry in the user-facing `settingsNav`.
- The `IntegrationsTab` only exists as an admin panel tab at `/admin` — regular users cannot see it.
- To expose integrations to regular users you would need to: add an entry to `settingsNav` in `JobSidebar.tsx`, add a `/integrations` route in `App.tsx`, and create a user-facing integrations page (or reuse/adapt `IntegrationsTab`).
